ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from limited amino acid deamination at 70-85 days ripening.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from raw milk and alpine pasture Tyr/Trp catabolism.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides from rennet/plasmin proteolysis, balanced by salt.

blue_moldy.reason: Low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from beta-oxidation, no Penicillium mold.

browning.reason: Limited Maillard due to depleted lactose and low reducing sugars in aged curd.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by mesophilic starters/NSLAB.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic/hexanoic acids from lipoprotein lipase and microbial lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 52% fat-in-dry-matter and 34.8% moisture give smooth pressed-paste mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive cooked-pressed casein network at 3 months, not yet crystalline.

firmness.reason: Cooked, pressed, 65.2% total solids gives dense elastic alpine paste.

floral_honey.reason: Pasture terpenes plus phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe catabolism.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol plus free fatty acids via esterases.

goaty.reason: Slight branched-chain C8-C10 acids from up to 10% goat milk in PDO recipe.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and cooked-curd notes from Leu/Ile proteolysis.

melt.reason: pH ~5.4 with intact colloidal calcium allows good flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Minimal 1-octen-3-ol, no surface mold, only low pasture-derived earthiness.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from coalesced milk fat globules on heating at ~53% FDM.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol; cooked curd gives no smoke character.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low acetic/propionic acid from heterofermentative NSLAB, pH ~5.4.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated, cooked non-pasta-filata curd lacks aligned stretchable casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methional from Met catabolism plus mild whey-protein heating.

sweet.reason: Sweet Ala/Pro/Gly amino acids and low salt perception, lactose depleted.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate from casein proteolysis by chymosin/plasmin/NSLAB.
